title: Turtle Riders Over Lavender Fields
description: Two men wearing hats and glasses ride a large green sea turtle with purple spots on its head. The turtle is flying through a surreal night sky filled with geometric constellations, spirals, and a red planet with rings, while a small astronaut stands among purple lavender fields below.
